title: Draft Employee's Compensation Chapter VII source-readiness mapping
sourceGaps: Qualified review is still required for Chapter VII interpretation, First/Second Schedule applicability, ESI-overlap routing and State or Union Territory implementation.
Customer worker classification and ESI coverage are not independently verified and are not provider inputs.
Individual accident, occupational-disease, medical, disablement, dependency, wage, liability, compensation, claim, appeal and recovery facts are outside this pack.
State-specific competent-authority, reporting and notification instruments may be onboarded later as bounded source identities; they are not needed to create individual outcomes in Wave 5E.
